activities.name: Last run of 2024
activities.description:
PBs across the board this year at distances attempted. Most happy with the sub 1.30 at hackney and then bringing it down further to 1.24 at robin hood half (and also getting sub 19 at Finsbury parkrun!) 

Still thinking about what could've been at Valencia if I didn't get injured - but looking forward to next year. Maybe we will try a marathon again...

Edit: but most importantly I've had a great time running with all my friends
